title: Bava Beccaris massacre
text: The Bava Beccaris massacre, named after the Italian general Fiorenzo Bava Beccaris, was the repression of widespread food riots in Milan, Italy, on 6–10 May 1898. In Italy the suppression of these demonstrations is also known as Fatti di Maggio or I Moti di Milano del 1898. Between 80 and 400 demonstrators were killed, as well as two soldiers, and between 450 and 2,000 were wounded.
